title: 공동주택 신축 · 역타 · 슬래브 하부굴착 — Final World Art Brief
visualGoal: A commercial-game high-oblique under-slab excavation world where limited visibility, vertical muck-out logistics and equipment-worker interfaces are understandable before any HUD overlay.

camera.cropRule: preserve the locked G5 topology; image generation never authors gameplay coordinates

mustRead: existing/top-down concrete slab overhead and columns
low headroom and shadowed blind zones
separated or actively controlled plant/worker routes
temporary lighting that explains visibility state
mustNotRead: workers wandering between machines without access control
HUD, text, labels, route lines, pad markers, warning icons or logos
lighting: realistic construction work lighting with shadowed under-slab depth; no fantasy glow
oneGenerationRule: Generate or edit one full-bleed WORLD plate only. Do not create a project board, infographic, asset sheet or alternate views.
